claim: The verifier must answer the speed latch's IN 0x253B from a NextREG model instead of replaying it from the recording or counting it as a port access.

evidence.text: The verifier answers IN 0x253B from its NextREG model (_NS.sel / nr_read).
'Port access in a hook' failed on the latch's IN (0x253B); it is answered from the NextREG model (_NS.read).
